name: Focus Carousel
description: An infinite image carousel for React with one image in focus: it's large and in colour, the rest shrink, grey, blur and fade away from it, with its title and caption underneath. Drag with momentum, wheel, arrow keys or click. No dependencies.

props.name: items
props.description: The images, with the title and caption shown under the one in focus. The row loops.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Width of the focused card in px; scaled down to fit smaller containers.

props.name: sideSize
props.description: Size of the side cards relative to the focused one.

props.name: sideCount
props.description: Visible cards on each side of the focus.

props.name: blurStep
props.description: Blur added per step away from the focus, in px (up to 12).

props.name: sideGrey
props.description: Grayscale on the side cards, from 0 (full colour) to 1.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Colour of the title, caption and marker.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height.
